phenomenon_scale.label: 27 µm
phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength at melanophore-contact scale

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = largest eigenvalue of J - k^2 D
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v), lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c
equations.anisotropy: D_AP = alpha * D_u, D_DV = D_u; stripe mode selected when alpha is large
equations.discrete_laplacian: L = -4 sin^2(kx/2) - 4 sin^2(ky/2) on the periodic grid

parameters.note_a: Production a is lowered from the classic 0.1 tutorial value to 0.05 so the discrete critical wavelength is 4.19 cells and explicit Euler at dt=0.04 stays positive. Jacobian f_u remains positive (0.8947).
parameters.boundary: periodic on a flank patch; no-flux is not required at this cellular window

chronoseries_delta_at_this_scale.conserved: Melanophore-contact wavelength stays near 27 µm (2.71e-5 m) across the three extant Danio. Geological age is 0 Ma for all three; the series is phylogenetic, not a fossil time series.
chronoseries_delta_at_this_scale.predecessor_Danio_margaritatus: alpha -> 1.05 everywhere, so the critical mode is a spot/ocellus. Hexagonal center spacing is (2/sqrt(3))*lambda_c, longer than the stripe wavelength.
chronoseries_delta_at_this_scale.focal_Danio_nigrofasciatus: alpha_dorsal = 6 keeps short horizontal stripelets; alpha_ventral = 1.15 below mid-flank breaks those stripelets into spots (broken ventral stripes).
chronoseries_delta_at_this_scale.successor_Danio_rerio: alpha = 8.5 on the whole flank locks continuous stripes. Cellular lambda does not jump; long-range iridophore coupling (Volkening 2018, Kcnj13 in Podobnik 2020) is what changes, and it is represented here only through alpha.
chronoseries_delta_at_this_scale.not_this_slot: Organ-scale stripe spacing (~1 mm, slot 1203) is a different tier and is not retuned here.

empirical_claims: Nakamasu et al. 2009: melanophore-xanthophore interactions in Danio satisfy a short-range activation, long-range inhibition Turing rule and can produce stripes or spots.
Parichy 2006: adult Danio patterns diverge by where post-embryonic pigment cells are recruited; D. nigrofasciatus keeps a striped dorsum and a broken ventral field.
Volkening and Sandstede 2018: iridophores stabilize zebrafish stripes and permit spot-like variability in other Danio.
Podobnik et al. 2020: Kcnj13 evolution tracks colour-pattern diversification across Danio.

This reconstruction does not claim that 27 µm was measured on the vendored whole-body photograph (that photo does not resolve 27 µm). 27 µm is the catalog cellular wavelength imposed on the dispersion relation by the grid spacing dx.
